requirements.sourceQuote: The essential requirement for admission into the ITM programme is the successful acquirement of a higher education entrance qualification (Fachhochschulreife, high school diploma, A-Levels, Baccalaureat, Gao Kao, etc.).

German language skills
**A1** required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: 
  * Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat A1

English language skills
**B2** required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: 
  * IELTS Academic: 5.5
